schadstoff.title: Radiation protection calculations
schadstoff.allFilled: All fields are filled. Clear one field to run a calculation.

abstand.title: Inverse-square law of distance
abstand.instructions: D1² × R1 = D2² × R2 — Enter 3 values, the 4th is computed. Leave the field to compute empty.

schutzwert.title: Shielding factor
schutzwert.instructions: R = R₀ / S^n — Enter 3 values, the 4th is computed. Leave the field to compute empty.

aufenthalt.title: Exposure time
aufenthalt.instructions: t = D / R — Enter 2 values, the 3rd is computed. Leave the field to compute empty.

nuklid.title: Dose rate from nuclide activity
nuklid.instructions: Ḣ = Γ × A — Compute dose rate at 1m distance from activity or vice versa. Leave the field to compute empty.

einheiten.title: Unit conversion
einheiten.instructions: Convert dose and dose rate. 1 R ≈ 0.01 Sv (gamma, soft tissue).

kernwaffen.title: Nuclear weapon / fallout
kernwaffen.workflowIntro: First calculate the reference dose rate R₁ at H+1; it is automatically used for all further calculations (dose rate at another time, total dose). Durations as text: "2.5", "2h 15min" or "45min".
kernwaffen.section1Instructions: R₁ = R(t) · t^{exp}. Enter directly or compute from a measurement R(t) at time t after burst — the empty field is computed.
kernwaffen.section2Instructions: With R₁ = {r1} mSv/h: enter time t' → R(t') = R₁ · t'^(-1.2). The empty field is computed.
kernwaffen.section2NoR1: Enter or compute R₁ in section 1 first to continue here.
kernwaffen.section3Title: 3. Total dose during stay in the fallout area
kernwaffen.section3Instructions: With R₁ = {r1} mSv/h: D = 5·R₁·(Te^(-0.2) − (Te+Ts)^(-0.2)). Enter three of Te, Ts, D — the fourth is computed.
kernwaffen.section3NoR1: Enter or compute R₁ in section 1 first to continue here.
kernwaffen.r1: Reference dose rate R₁ at H+1 (mSv/h)

dosisNomogramm.title: Dose nomogram (FM 3-3-1)
dosisNomogramm.description: Five scales: D, R₁, reference line M, Ts (curve), Te (diagonal). Step 1 (straight line Te → Ts → reference line) reads the multiplier M; step 2 (straight line reference line → R₁ → D) yields the total dose D = R₁ · M.

dosisleistungsNomogramm.title: Dose-rate nomogram
dosisleistungsNomogramm.description: Three scales: R(t) left, time t middle, R₁ right. Entered values are circles; computed values diamonds in a different colour. The line illustrates R(t) = R₁ · t^(-1.2).
